markdown.markdown:
My research lies in probability theory, with a focus on Stein's method, extreme
value theory and stable distributions in general. After doing my PhD under the supervision of L. Decreusefond at Télécom Paris, I joined the School of Physical and Mathematical Sciences, NTU, Singapore as a Research Fellow. My main project consists in studying the interactions between the central limit theorem and the regular variation assumption in the context of the aggregation of random variables. 


1. **B. Costacèque**, N. Privault.
   Convergence rates for the extreme value theorem via Stein's method.
   Submitted to *Extremes*, 2026.
   [[arXiv](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.17562)]
   [[PDF](https://arxiv.org/pdf/2608.17562)]

## Published and accepted papers

1. **B. Costacèque**, L. Decreusefond.
   [Convergence rate for the coupon collector's problem with Stein's method](https://arxiv.org/abs/2501.06535).
   *Stochastic Processes and their Applications*, in press, 2026.
   [[arXiv](https://arxiv.org/abs/2501.06535)] [[PDF](https://arxiv.org/pdf/2501.06535)]

## Preprints

1. **B. Costacèque**, L. Decreusefond.
   [Functional analysis of multivariate max-stable distributions](https://arxiv.org/abs/2509.02200).
   *arXiv preprint*, September 2025.
   [[arXiv](https://arxiv.org/abs/2509.02200)] [[PDF](https://arxiv.org/pdf/2509.02200)]

2. **B. Costacèque**, L. Decreusefond.
   [Stein's method for max-stable random vectors](https://arxiv.org/abs/2507.00463).
   *arXiv preprint*, July 2025.
   [[arXiv](https://arxiv.org/abs/2507.00463)] [[PDF](https://arxiv.org/pdf/2507.00463)]
